honest_verdict.reading: LOGO GBM full PR-AUC 0.282 beats raw p72 rank (0.221) and shuffled-W (0.165), so the letter of the p72 kill test passes. It loses to ranking by -eta_hours (0.422) with no model. W-only is 0.151 (barely above pos-rate 0.110). Mireye nearest_fire_perimeter_distance_m is unused (delta 0) and ranks at chance. The withheld E dist_perim_m leak ranks 0.331 — much weaker than the 0.96 scar-label result, so R0 actually changed the task. Role D (lightning climatology) is the only W role that clearly helps (+0.063). Negative retrain deltas (elevation, snow, E.wind_speed, even ENG.eta_hours) mean those columns were hurting the joint GBM on this N; permutation on a 3-positive GSS test is too noisy to override LOGO. GSS20 full mean 0.456±0.196 is a lottery and is not the claim. Engine is rothermel_huygens_v1 seeded from GeoMAC first rings + HRRR-at-seed, not compiled ELMFIRE, and almost all multi-time series are GeoMAC 2019 not WFIGS Daily.
